rule: Out of a stock only when both SMH and that stock close below their own 200-day average; back in when either closes above it. Decided at the close, acted on at the next open.
tested: Pre-registered tests on Tiingo daily data, 13 Nov 2026: 16 exit rules in 3 rounds (trend filters, volatility, radar days, ATR stops, trimming, EMA/Hull averages, slope, credit stress, volatility targeting, rotation, VXN). Rule E was the most consistent; none beat simply holding on return in every period.

periods.name: 2014 to 2024
periods.note: Daily-rebalanced equal-weight basket of MU, WDC, LRCX, AMAT, ASML, AMD, 0.10% cost per switch.

periods.name: 2023 to Nov 2026
periods.note: Same basket plus SNDK from Feb 2025. Bought once and left to drift, rule E kept the full return (87.6% vs 87.0%).

periods.name: 2002 to 2026
periods.note: Includes the 2008 crash, where holding fell 72%.

best_near_worst: 12 of SMH's 20 best days since 2001 came within a month of one of its 20 worst days.
